_note_worktree: permissions.deny.EnterWorktree below is retained as a marker but does NOT prevent Claude Desktop / Cowork from spawning sessions in .claude/worktrees/. That creation happens before settings load — no tool call to deny. The real safeguard is the hooks.SessionStart entry below, which warns when cwd lands under .claude/worktrees/. To stop the auto-worktree behavior permanently, disable Cowork's worktree-isolation for this project in the Claude Desktop app. See memory/feedback_no_auto_worktree.md.
